# Ashnik

> > Ashnik provides enterprise open-source database solutions, specializing in PostgreSQL consulting, cloud migrations, and database management services.

Ashnik appears to be a technology consulting firm focused on database technologies, particularly PostgreSQL deployments on cloud platforms like AWS. The site includes technical FAQs addressing database replication, version upgrades, and enterprise database management challenges.

## Key Topics

- PostgreSQL
- AWS database migrations
- Database replication
- Version upgrades
- Async replication
- Real-time replication
- Cloud database management
- Enterprise open-source
- Database consulting
- PostgreSQL on AWS
- Database performance
- High availability
- Database architecture

- [If It's Async, Don't You Think It's Not Real-time Replication Or Considered It As Near Real-time Replication?](https://ashnik.com/faq-items/if-its-async-dont-you-think-its-not-real-time-replication-or-considered-it-as-near-real-time-replication): FAQ: Clarifying async vs real-time database replication terminology
